recorded_before: any candidate reference KLF12 value was read; the rules pre-registration follows in its own later commit

D1_biological_context.rule: a gate-qualifying reference is in-vitro hormone-treated human endometrial epithelium; fertile mid-secretory tissue is NOT an automatic RR08 match for hormone_treated and may be used only as contextual evidence or as a fallback requiring a new owner decision

protocol_tiers.T2_one_component_missing: E2 + progestogen + exactly one of cAMP or XAV939, the missing component recorded explicitly

D1_biological_context.cnt: remains unresolved; never inferred as unstimulated or E2-primed

D2_min_reference_donors.scope: a minimum for assumption-conditioned scenario generation only, not a claim of population adequacy
D2_min_reference_donors.donor_rule: identifiable independent biological donors only; clones and technical replicates do not count; every qualifying donor is used when more than three qualify
D2_min_reference_donors.canonical_location: src/dt_adoc/personalization/phase2a_contract.py mapping_specification(), value 3, provenance owner_decided, regenerated into docs/phase2a/; no second Phase-2B-only value

preference_order: a genuine published per-cell KLF12-high definition, if one exists
otherwise a pre-registered empirical state-separation procedure
D3_threshold_derivation.separation_requirements: a two-component separation qualifies only if it yields a unique ordered high/low separation and passes a one-state/null-specificity calibration analogous to the previous KLF12 work; a lattice or dropout split is failure, not a threshold
D3_threshold_derivation.forbidden: an arbitrary donor quantile as the primary definition, or labelling one reference_state_separation
D3_threshold_derivation.report: primary boundary plus lower and upper pre-registered sensitivity boundaries, all reported

D4_quantity.rule: never switch quantities after seeing which gives a nicer separation; the separation and null-calibration criteria still apply after normalization

D5_comparability.rule: raw FASTQ reprocessed through the pinned ADOC processing/reference stack as closely as technically possible; no cross-dataset calibration invented to rescue processed-only candidates
D5_comparability.failure: same-pipeline processing not achievable -> BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY; if chemistry makes the pinned stack genuinely incompatible, stop rather than accept a different pipeline
D5_comparability.original_study_pipeline_version: irrelevant once raw FASTQ is reprocessed through ours

D6_epithelium.rule: the union of the authors' epithelial annotations, mapped to the broad epithelial compartment using metadata only
D6_epithelium.forbidden: an EPCAM or any other expression threshold

hierarchy: accession lexical order as the deterministic tie-breaker
D7_candidate_selection.forbidden_inputs: KLF12 distribution, model output, downstream scenario behaviour

D8_access_and_overlap.controlled_access: EGA/dbGaP datasets excluded from this increment; no access application started to unblock Phase 2B
D8_access_and_overlap.fcs_linked: not permanently excluded, but BLOCKED_DONOR_OVERLAP until donor-code disjointness from SZ09/SZ10/SZ25 is positively documented; independence is never inferred from different accession numbers

citation_fields.rule: no DOI is minted merely to satisfy the validator, and a dataset accession is not cited as though it were the source of a threshold method; threshold_derivation cites the actual published methodological source if the method has one
citation_fields.if_custom: if the pre-registered derivation is genuinely custom and has no valid DOI or accession, stop and flag that the RR14 citation schema needs an owner-approved adjustment; do not game the field

decisions.instruction: proceed with C1 and C2, apply the minimal canonical RR11 update before value access, commit C3 as the value-blind rules pre-registration and stop; report the C3 SHA and the frozen rules before C4
